summary: Ukrainian drone strikes targeted multiple Russian energy infrastructure sites including refineries in Tatarstan, Komsomolsk-on-Amur, and Oryol, with fires reported at a Wildberries logistics complex in Voronezh region. Russian forces launched coordinated missile and drone attacks across Ukraine, hitting Kyiv with ballistic missiles and striking infrastructure in Odesa and other regions. Ground operations continued along multiple front lines with advances near Pischane and ongoing combat in Kharkiv, Sumy, and Zaporizhzhia directions.
key_points: Ukrainian drones struck key Russian logistics and energy infrastructure including a Wildberries complex in Voronezh region (156,000 m²), Rosneft refinery in Komsomolsk-on-Amur, and Oskolnefteorgsintez plant in Oryol region, approximately 2000 km from Ukrainian border. (Source: @UkraineNow/83350)

Russian forces attacked Kyiv with multiple ballistic missiles, hitting a children's hospital in Shevchenkivskyi district and damaging logistics facilities in Bucha district, with air raid alerts activated across the city. (Source: @eRadarrua/104900)

Russian Tu-95MS bomber was relocated from Engels airbase to Olenya airbase after being equipped with cruise missiles, indicating preparation for extended-range strike operations. (Source: @eRadarrua/104938)

Ukrainian military intelligence reported successful strikes on Russian air defense systems including Buk-M3 system, ammunition depots in Luhansk region, command posts in Belgorod region, and six UAV control points. (Source: @UkraineNow/83360)

Russian 'Sever' grouping conducted offensive operations near Kazachya Lopan on Kharkiv front, with Ukrainian counterattack groups destroyed and ongoing firefights in Shcherbakovka, Kudiivka, and Goptovka areas. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32352)

Russian forces launched 15 Shahed drones against Mykolaiv, with Ukrainian air defense systems responding to multiple aerial threats across southern and central Ukraine throughout the day. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70057)

Ukrainian forces advanced near Pischane, with DeepState map updates showing enemy movements in the area while Ukrainian military continues fundraising for optical cables to support 46th separate mechanized brigade drone operations. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23732)

sections.executive_summary: Ukrainian drone strikes simultaneously hit multiple Russian energy infrastructure targets including refineries in Tatarstan, Komsomolsk-on-Amur, and Oryol region, with fires reported at a major Wildberries logistics complex in Voronezh. Russian forces responded with coordinated missile and drone attacks across Ukraine, striking Kyiv with ballistic missiles and hitting infrastructure in Odesa and other regions. Ground operations intensified along multiple front lines with advances near Pischane and ongoing combat in Kharkiv, Sumy, and Zaporizhzhia directions.

points: Russian forces launched coordinated missile and drone attacks across Ukraine, with ballistic missiles striking Kyiv's Shevchenkivskyi district hitting a children's hospital and damaging logistics facilities in Bucha district. Multiple air raid alerts were activated throughout the day with air defense systems engaging incoming threats. (Source: @eRadarrua/104900)

Russian 'Sever' grouping conducted offensive operations near Kazachya Lopan on the Kharkiv front, with Ukrainian counterattack groups destroyed and ongoing firefights reported in Shcherbakovka, Kudiivka, and Goptovka areas. Combat operations also continued in Volchansk area villages including Vasilievka, Shevchenkove, and Petropavlovka. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32352)

Russian forces launched 15 Shahed drones against Mykolaiv, with Ukrainian air defense systems responding to multiple aerial threats across southern and central Ukraine. Additional drone threats were tracked moving toward Odesa region from the Black Sea and western Mykolaiv region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70057)

Ukrainian military intelligence reported successful strikes on Russian air defense systems including Buk-M3 system, ammunition depots in Luhansk region, command posts in Belgorod region, and six UAV control points. These strikes demonstrated capability to penetrate deep into Russian-occupied territory. (Source: @UkraineNow/83360)

Odesa's public transportation system remained out of service for the third consecutive day following attacks on the Thermal Power Plant and seven electrical substations. City infrastructure continued to experience disruptions from ongoing Russian strikes on energy facilities. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32355)

Ukrzaliznytsia suspended ticket sales for certain routes due to Russian attacks damaging locomotives, cars, and railway infrastructure. Reconstruction of logistics and train schedules was underway with potential technical failures and long queues at railway ticket offices during peak hours. (Source: @UkraineNow/83351)

Ukrainian drone strikes hit key Russian energy infrastructure including Rosneft refinery in Komsomolsk-on-Amur in Khabarovsk Krai, producing automotive gasoline, diesel fuel, and marine fuel. The facility is described as one of the key suppliers in the Russian Far East. (Source: @UkraineNow/83350)

A major Wildberries logistics complex in Voronezh region was set ablaze, covering 156,000 square meters and described as one of the largest in Russia. The facility was among the key targets in the coordinated Ukrainian drone attack campaign. (Source: @UkraineNow/83350)

Oskolnefteorgsintez plant in Oryol region was struck, located nearly 2000 km from the Ukrainian border. The attack was part of a series of strikes targeting critical Russian industrial infrastructure across multiple regions. (Source: @UkraineNow/83350)

Russian forces launched 13 drones flying towards Moscow, with air defense systems shooting down multiple UAVs during the night. A logistics facility belonging to Wildberries in Voronezh region was evacuated following the attack. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32352)

Russian 'Sever' grouping conducted offensive operations on multiple fronts including Kharkiv, Sumy, and Belgorod regions. In Belgorod region, civilian casualties were reported including injuries from shrapnel in Vesyolaya Lopan and fatalities in Novaya Tavolzhanka where a drone struck a private house. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32352)

Russian forces used Zircon hypersonic missiles to strike a target in Kiev's Zhuliany area, with warehouses also catching fire in Shevchenkivskyi district. The attack demonstrated continued capability to deploy advanced weaponry against Ukrainian urban centers. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32352)

Russian forces advanced near Pischane, with DeepState map updates showing enemy movements in the area. Ukrainian military continued fundraising efforts for optical cables to support 46th separate mechanized brigade drone operations in the region. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23732)

On the Kharkiv front, Russian 'Sever' grouping conducted offensive operations in the village of Kazachya Lopan. Ukrainian counterattack groups were destroyed with ongoing firefights in Shcherbakovka, Kudiivka, and Goptovka areas. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32352)

Fighting continued in the Krasny Liman area with Russian forces counterattacking from the direction of Redkodub, north of the town. The situation remained fluid with both sides engaged in positional combat. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32352)

On the Druzhkovka front, Russian forces attempted to counterattack Toretsk, which was previously taken by Ukrainian troops. The counterattack operations were ongoing with unclear outcomes at the time of reporting. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32352)

In the Volchansk area, fighting took place in the village of Vasilievka, near Shevchenkove and Petropavlovka. Additional combat operations occurred in the Velikoburluk direction near the village of Vodyanoye and west of Ustinovka. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32352)

On the Sumy front, the 'Sever' group maintained positions on the same lines with Ukrainian 12th Separate Mechanized Brigade units redeployed to the area. UAV units occupied apartments on upper floors of residential buildings in the city for operational purposes. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32352)

Russian forces launched multiple ballistic missiles at Kyiv, with two missiles striking the right bank area. Air raid alerts were activated with air defense systems engaging incoming threats throughout the night. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70053)

A ballistic missile threat was reported from Voronezh and Taganrog regions, with air defense systems on high alert. The threat assessment indicated potential for further missile strikes against northern Ukrainian territories. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70040)

Kyiv experienced air raid alerts with 13 drones flying towards the city from the north. Air defense systems successfully intercepted multiple UAVs during the nighttime attack. (Source: @eRadarrua/104887)

Russian forces launched Iskander-M ballistic missiles from Voronezh region, with threat assessments indicating potential strikes against central Ukrainian targets. Air defense systems remained on high alert throughout the region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70061)

Multiple rocket attacks were reported in the Poltava region, with a ballistic missile striking the Mirgorod district. The attack was part of a broader pattern of Russian strikes against northern Ukrainian infrastructure. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70063)

Air raid alerts were activated in Kyiv following Russian missile launches, with air defense systems successfully intercepting incoming threats. The city remained under heightened security alert throughout the night. (Source: @eRadarrua/104939)

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces continue to demonstrate capability for coordinated multi-domain attacks across Ukraine, combining ballistic missiles, cruise missiles, and drone swarms to target both military and civilian infrastructure. The use of Zircon hypersonic missiles in Kiev indicates access to advanced weaponry, while simultaneous strikes on energy infrastructure in remote Russian regions suggest expanded operational reach. Ukrainian counterattacks have successfully penetrated deep into Russian territory, targeting critical logistics and energy facilities including the major Wildberries complex in Voronezh region. Ground operations remain intense along multiple front lines, particularly in Kharkiv and Sumy directions where Russian 'Sever' grouping conducts offensive operations. The escalation pattern suggests both sides are expanding operational scope beyond immediate front lines.
sections.regional_response: Ukrainian air defense systems have successfully intercepted multiple Russian drone and missile attacks, though some projectiles have penetrated defenses causing damage to critical infrastructure including hospitals and logistics facilities. European allies continue discussions regarding additional military aid, with particular focus on Patriot missile interceptor donations from Spain, Greece, and other nations, though political will remains constrained by U.S. administration positions. Ukrainian military intelligence has demonstrated expanded strike capability against Russian deep rear targets, successfully hitting energy infrastructure and logistics facilities across multiple regions including the Russian Far East. Domestic Ukrainian law enforcement has intensified investigations into potential corruption within military recruitment systems, with 76 TCC managers under suspicion for alleged illegal mobilization exemptions affecting nearly 2,500 individuals. Railway infrastructure continues to experience disruptions from Russian attacks, forcing Ukrzaliznytsia to suspend ticket sales for certain routes and implement revised logistics schedules.
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian military appears to be preparing for extended-range strike operations with Tu-95MS bomber relocation from Engels to Olenya airbase following cruise missile arming, suggesting potential for deeper penetration missions. Ukrainian drone campaign has achieved significant psychological impact by successfully striking targets nearly 2000 km inside Russian territory, including the major Wildberries logistics complex in Voronezh region. Ground operations indicate Russian 'Sever' grouping is actively conducting offensive operations across multiple axes including Kharkiv, Sumy, and Belgorod regions, with civilian casualties reported in border areas. Ukrainian military fundraising efforts for optical cables demonstrate ongoing adaptation to maintain drone operational capabilities despite resource constraints. The pattern of simultaneous strikes across vast distances suggests coordinated planning and execution capabilities on both sides, with particular emphasis on targeting critical infrastructure to degrade logistical and energy capabilities.
